convert_pth_to_detectron2: run the script to convert a third-party .pth pretrained model to Detectron2 .pkl format
convert_resnet50_miil: run the script with --path resnet50_miil_21k.pth to convert a ResNet50 MIIL model
convert_swin_transformer: run the script with --path swin_base_patch4_window7_224_22k.pth to convert a Swin Transformer model
extract_state_dict: run the script to extract the state dict from nested model keys like model or state_dict
save_pickle_with_heuristics: run the script to save a model as a pickle file with matching_heuristics enabled
